_comment: Bootstrap config for a new Convex deployment. Copy this file to .convex-bootstrap.json and fill in the values. The file is gitignored so secrets won't be committed. Use the string '<generate>' for ENCRYPTION_KEY and CONVEX_TEST_SECRET to have the script generate them automatically.
_required_comment: REQUIRED — script will fail if these are missing
_llm_providers_comment: LLM providers — at least one is required for workflows to execute. Leave blank to skip.
_tools_comment: Tool API keys — optional. Only set the ones you want available as system-level fallbacks.
_langsmith_comment: LangSmith tracing — optional. Leave all blank to disable.
